supportingSources.quote: Some courses are delivered in a 14- to 17-week format (with one entry date per semester)
supportingSources.reviewMethod: Official current 2026–2027 catalog page opened and the Structure section inspected through the connected web research tool.

supportingSources.title: TESU current undergraduate course engagement and course calendars
supportingSources.quote: Merely logging into or viewing courses does not constitute academic engagement.

supportingSources.title: TESU accelerated undergraduate course format as a separate option
supportingSources.quote: Accelerated courses do not have individual assignment due dates or late-penalty policies.

notes: This schedule classification describes the standard university online-coursework baseline for the exact listed degree editions only.
e-Pack, TECEP, prior learning assessment and accelerated sections are separate credit-earning options with different pacing; their availability is not inferred for every selected course.

Asynchronous discussions have no specified login time, while standard online courses retain a week-by-week assignment schedule. No live class time, universal proctoring requirement, absence of exams, section availability or completion date is inferred.
